answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments conditioned on two widely-used datasets: RealToxicityPrompts (Gehman et al., 2020) and a QA-dataset ... Experimental results show that our MIL-Decoding method achieves faster decoding speed than other decoding-time methods, while it outperforms all other detoxification methods in reducing toxic text generation.
datasets: Jigsaw Toxic Comment Classification Challenge Dataset

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our generated outputs for toxicity, fluency and diversity. ... generation toxicity with the toxicity score given by Perspective API ... Generation fluency and diversity are measured using the mean perplexity of generated continuations and the mean number of distinct n-grams.

answer_4.quote: In addition to automatic evaluation, we carry out human evaluation on toxicity and fluency of generated text ... each continuation is evaluated by two annotators, who rate fluency on a scale of 1 to 5 and rate toxicity on a scale of 0 to 2.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate fluency on a 1‑5 scale (1 = very confused, 5 = very fluent) and toxicity on a 0‑2 scale (0 = non‑toxic, 2 = toxic).
